'''Olana Chion''' was a [[human]] [[Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. [[Anakin Skywalker's Knighting Ceremony|Promoted]] to the rank of Knight early in the war alongside [[Anakin Skywalker]] and several others, Chion served until near the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the conflict. In [[19 BBY]], shortly before the war ended, Chion attended a briefing in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]], leaving as Skywalker arrived.

==Biography==
Olana Chion, a member of the [[Jedi Order]], was [[Knighting Ceremony|promoted]] to the rank of [[Jedi Knight]]<ref name="Brotherhood" /> in [[22 BBY]]<ref name="Brotherhood Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']] to [[22 BBY]].</ref> at a [[Anakin Skywalker's Knighting Ceremony|mass Knighting Ceremony]] held in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Temple training ground|training courtyard]] [[Standard week|weeks]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. All of the new Knights, who besides Chion included [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[D'urban Wen-Hurd]], [[Keer Stenwyt]], [[Cyruss Okent]],<ref name="Brotherhood" /> [[Thirteenth Sister|Iskat Akaris]],<ref name="Rise of the Red Blade">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''</ref> and several others, had had their advancement to the rank rushed due to the needs of the war.<ref name="Brotherhood" />

The end of the ceremony was interrupted by news from Republic [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] of an [[Cadesura disaster|attack]] on the neutral [[planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia]], and the new [[Jedi]] Knights were invited to stay alongside the older Knights and [[Jedi Master]]s for a discussion of the situation. The next [[Standard day|day]], most of the new Knights, including Chion, attended a reception in [[Emperor's office|Palpatine's office]] in their honor.<ref name="Brotherhood" />

In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Episode III Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> near the end of the Clone Wars, Chion attended a briefing in the Jedi Temple led by Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] regarding the status of the ongoing [[Outer Rim Sieges]] on<ref name="ROTS" /> worlds<ref name="COTR">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref><ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> such as [[Boz Pity]] and [[Saleucami]]. Chion departed the briefing room at the same [[time]] as Skywalker entered it, with the two Jedi Knights passing each other in the corridor. The war was brought to an [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] just days later.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Olana Chion was a [[human]] with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] and light skin.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Equipment==
Chion wore brown [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Olana Chion first appeared in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> as a Jedi extra played by [[Dominique Chionchio]].<ref name="Dark Side Databank">{{Blog|thefragrantwookiee|44|Olana Chion: A 'What's the story?' Story}}</ref> Chion was first identified in the [[2022]] novel [[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']], written by [[Mike Chen (author)|Mike Chen]].<ref name="Brotherhood" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Olana Chion/Legends|O-Lana]] first appeared in [[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth|''The Fight for Truth'']], the ninth novel in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] junior novel series, written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[2000]].<ref name="Fight for Truth">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref> She was first identified as Olana Chion and [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] as the extra from the film in a "[[What's The Story?]]" entry<ref name="Olana DB">{{DB|character|olanachion|Chion, Olana}}</ref> primarily written by [[Ian Tapley]], who [[Tuckerization|derived]] Chion's surname from that of Chionchio. Submitted as part of the fourth round of the contest, the entry on Chion was published on [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature<ref name="Dark Side Databank" /> on [[February 3]], [[2006]].<ref name="Round 4">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20060203.html|text=What's the Story, Round 4}}</ref>
